summary: Major community package releases take the latest ansible-core and collection releases and may break things, while minor releases only accept backwards-compatible collection updates under semantic versioning. Also points to porting guides, pip install and old release downloads.
questions: Can a minor Ansible package update include breaking changes?
How do I install the Ansible package?
Where can I download old Ansible releases?
How do I prepare playbooks for a new major Ansible version?

answer_card.title: Semantic versioning in the community package
answer_card.answer_md:
- **Major** releases include the latest ansible-core and collections and can contain breaking changes.
- **Minor** releases only take backwards-compatible collection updates. If Ansible 3.0.0 shipped community.general 2.0.0, every 3.x keeps a 2.x community.general.
- Use the porting guides when upgrading, install with `pip` (2.10+), and find old releases at https://releases.ansible.com/ansible/.
